# Passport renewal checklist

- The current passport, undamaged.
- One recent photo that meets the size and background rules.
- The completed renewal form, signed and dated.
- Payment for the fee, by the method the office accepts.

Renew at least six months before any trip; some countries refuse entry on a passport with less
than six months left. Keep a photocopy of the photo page with the travel documents.
